events.title: Demo 0.3.2 - Reroll & Banish Improvements, death wave rebalance and bug fixes
events.summary: NewReroll and Banish on every level-up. Reroll and Banish charges, bought at the Vendor, now work on every level-up’s cards, not only at charge shrines. Reroll swaps all three cards for ones you were not just shown. Banish removes one card for the rest of the run, and once pressed it cannot be taken back. Both have new icons, and the Vendor says what each one does.ImprovedKilling the boss now gives 30 seconds before the death wave (was 10), counted down on the clock.Locked passive tree nodes now

events.title: Demo 0.3.1: Interface overhaul and minimap rework
events.summary: New Interface overhaul. The hideout stations, inventory, character sheet, Build screen, objectives log and run summary are rebuilt in one carved-stone style, with framed panels and stone tabs. Comparing gear now shows a green or red difference on each stat, and a warning when the new item would lose your current item's special effect. The character sheet shows where each stat comes from. Minimap rework. The minimap now draws streets and buildings as simple shapes, with icons half their old size.

events.title: Demo 0.3.0: First player experience and objective board rework
events.summary: New First player experience rework. The early game now teaches by playing instead of explaining up front. Your first run is a short, guided night in the city with a story to follow, and the rest of the game opens up over your next runs at a pace you choose: Guided or Experienced, picked when you start a new game. events.title: Demo Update - Plague and Burn spread fixes
events.summary: Fixed- Plague got stronger every time it spread from a dying enemy to a new one, with no limit. Late in a run a single Plague tick could kill a boss outright, which is how Lord Katzzav could take almost no damage and then die instantly.Balance- Plague keeps its damage when it spreads instead of multiplying it again on every jump.
